name: PM MUDRA - Shishu
description: Micro-credit for small income-generating businesses requiring loans up to Rs. 50,000.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free institutional credit up to Rs. 50,000.

name: PM MUDRA - Kishore
description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.

name: PM MUDRA - Tarun
description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.

name: PM MUDRA - Tarun Plus
description: Credit support above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free credit above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh.

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro enterprises in non-farm sectors.
benefitSummary: Credit-linked subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for services.

name: PMEGP 2nd Loan for Upgradation
description: Financial assistance for upgrading existing, well-performing PMEGP/MUDRA units.
benefitSummary: Subsidy of 15% to 20% on project cost up to Rs. 1 crore for manufacturing and Rs. 25 lakh for services.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 identified trades.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs. 3 lakh (Rs. 1L first tranche + Rs. 2L second tranche) at 5% interest rate, plus Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive.

name: PM SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro credit facility for urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.
benefitSummary: Working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs. 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.

name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Micro-finance through State Channelizing Agencies for small income-generating activities.
benefitSummary: Concessional micro credit up to Rs. 60,000 per beneficiary at 5% p.a. interest rate.

name: NSFDC Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana (AMY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Micro-finance routed through NBFC-MFIs for income-generating micro activities.
benefitSummary: Concessional micro finance up to Rs. 60,000 per beneficiary at interest rates not exceeding NBFC-MFI caps.

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Term credit finance for commercially viable income-generating projects.
benefitSummary: Term loan assistance up to 90% of project cost for projects costing up to Rs. 50 lakh at concessional interest rates.

name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Micro loans through cooperative societies and small finance entities for income generation.
benefitSummary: Micro loan assistance up to Rs. 44,000 per beneficiary at 4% p.a. interest rate.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates composite bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST and one Woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
benefitSummary: Bank composite loan between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore with tenure up to 7 years and moratorium up to 18 months.

name: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund for MSMEs (SMILE)
ministry: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Finance
description: Provides quasi-equity and soft term loans to meet required debt-equity ratios for setting up new MSMEs and financing expansion/modernization.
benefitSummary: Soft term loan and quasi-equity assistance up to Rs. 25 Crore directly through SIDBI.

name: NBCFDC New Swarnima Scheme for Women
description: Term loan assistance at concessional interest rate of 5% p.a. to backward class women entrepreneurs for self-employment.
benefitSummary: Term loan up to Rs. 2,00,000 at a concessional interest rate of 5% p.a.

name: NSTFDC Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY)
description: Concessional loan assistance exclusively for Scheduled Tribe women entrepreneurs undertaking self-employment ventures.
benefitSummary: Loan assistance up to Rs. 2,00,000 at a subsidized interest rate of 4% p.a.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Provides third-party credit guarantee cover to Member Lending Institutions extending collateral-free loans to MSEs.
benefitSummary: Credit guarantee coverage between 75% and 85% for loans up to Rs. 10 Crore without third-party collateral.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Subordinate Debt (CGSSD)
description: Guarantee cover to banks for extending subordinate debt up to 15% of promoter equity or Rs. 75 Lakh to promoters of stressed/NPA MSME units.
benefitSummary: 90% guarantee cover on subordinate debt up to Rs. 75 Lakh for stressed MSME revival.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
description: Credit guarantee coverage for loans and venture debt extended by financial institutions to DPIIT-recognized startups.
benefitSummary: Credit guarantee coverage up to Rs. 10 Crore per borrower for loans and venture debt.

name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy for establishing or upgrading individual micro food processing enterprises under ODOP.
benefitSummary: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to Rs. 10 Lakh per unit, with 10% minimum beneficiary contribution.

name: PMKSY - Creation / Expansion of Food Processing & Preservation Capacities (CEFPPC)
description: Capital grant-in-aid for creating modern processing and preservation capacities and modernization of existing food processing units.
benefitSummary: Capital grant-in-aid of 35% in General areas (up to Rs. 5 Crore) and 50% in NER/Hilly areas.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium-to-long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention.
benefitSummary: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to Rs. 2 Crore for up to 7 years, alongside CGTMSE guarantee fee coverage.

name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for SC/ST MSMEs
description: 25% upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance availed by SC/ST MSMEs for purchasing modern plant and machinery.
benefitSummary: 25% upfront capital subsidy (up to Rs. 25 Lakh on term loans up to Rs. 1 Crore) for acquiring modern plant and equipment.

name: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI) / Sub-scheme of ISAM
description: Back-ended capital subsidy scheme for creation of scientific storage infrastructure, cold storage, and rural godowns.
benefitSummary: 25% capital subsidy (33.33% for women/SC/ST/NER) up to Rs. 50 Lakh to Rs. 87.5 Lakh on bank credit for storage infrastructure.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Custom Hiring Centres (CHC)
nodalAgency: Mechanization & Technology Division / State Agriculture Departments
description: Provides 40% capital subsidy to rural youth and entrepreneurs to establish Custom Hiring Centres renting farm machinery.
benefitSummary: 40% financial assistance (up to Rs. 10 Lakh on a Rs. 25 Lakh project) for agricultural machinery rental centres.

name: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS) Scheme - Trade Fair Participation
description: Subsidizes space rent for MSEs participating in national trade fairs, exhibitions, and expos to market manufactured goods.
benefitSummary: 80% to 100% space rent subsidy (up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh for general micro enterprises and Rs. 3 Lakh for special categories).

name: PMS - Vendor Development Programmes (VDP) & Buyer-Seller Meets
description: B2G buyer-seller meets connecting MSE suppliers directly to CPSEs, defense, and railways.
benefitSummary: Free/subsidized matchmaking platforms and vendor qualification with public sector buyers.

name: MSME Sambandh (Public Procurement Monitoring Platform)
description: Statutory monitoring portal tracking CPSE compliance with the mandatory 25% annual MSE public procurement mandate.
benefitSummary: Tender intelligence, advance annual procurement forecasts, and tracking of CPSE procurement quotas for MSEs.

name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) - MSME Concessions & Fast-Track
description: National public procurement portal providing statutory concessions to MSEs including EMD waiver and turnover exemptions.
benefitSummary: 100% EMD waiver, prior turnover/experience exemptions, and access to all central/state government procurement tenders.

name: NSSH - Special Marketing Assistance Scheme (SMAS)
description: Reimbursement scheme covering marketing, stall rent, airfare, and freight for SC/ST MSEs participating in exhibitions.
benefitSummary: 100% financial reimbursement of stall charges, economy airfare, and freight charges for SC/ST entrepreneurs.

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
description: Subsidizes certification costs across Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers to promote Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing.
benefitSummary: Subsidy on certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium (+10% for Women/SC/ST/NER).

name: MSME Competitive (LEAN) Scheme
description: Provides 90% government funding toward consultant fees to eliminate shopfloor waste and improve manufacturing productivity.
benefitSummary: 90% government funding for consultant fees across Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Lean interventions.

name: MSME Digital Scheme (Digital MSME)
description: Financial subsidy for MSMEs to adopt cloud computing, ERP, digital accounting, and IoT solutions.
benefitSummary: Subsidized cloud services up to Rs. 1 Lakh to Rs. 5 Lakh per enterprise for transitioning to digital workflows.

name: Pharmaceutical Technology Upgradation Assistance Scheme (PTUAS)
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers (Department of Pharmaceuticals)
description: Subsidizes MSME pharma manufacturers to upgrade manufacturing infrastructure to revised Schedule M and WHO-GMP quality standards.
benefitSummary: Interest subvention of 6% p.a. or capital subsidy of 20% on eligible investment up to Rs. 1 Crore.

name: NSSH - Testing & Quality Certification Fee Reimbursement
description: Financial reimbursement for testing products at NABL/BIS accredited laboratories and obtaining national/international certifications.
benefitSummary: 100% reimbursement of testing fees at NABL labs; 80% to 100% reimbursement of BIS/ISO/FSSAI fees up to Rs. 1 Lakh per certification.

name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Incubation Component
description: Financial assistance for developing validated prototypes from innovative ideas through approved Host Institutes.
benefitSummary: Financial grant assistance up to Rs. 15 Lakh per approved idea for developing commercial prototypes.

name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Design Component
description: Co-funds expert design consultant and student design projects to improve product aesthetics and functional design.
benefitSummary: 75% grant for Micro (up to Rs. 40 Lakh) and 60% for Small/Medium (up to Rs. 40 Lakh) for engaging design consultants.

name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Component
description: Reimbursement of statutory registration and attorney fees for obtaining domestic and international patents, trademarks, and GIs.
benefitSummary: Reimbursement: up to Rs. 5 Lakh for Foreign Patent, Rs. 1 Lakh for Domestic Patent, Rs. 2 Lakh for GI, and Rs. 10,000 for Trademark.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype trials, and commercialization.
benefitSummary: Up to Rs. 20 Lakh as grant for proof of concept, and up to Rs. 50 Lakh as debt/convertible debenture for market launch.

name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
description: Organizes free and subsidized vocational, entrepreneurial, and management development training courses across India.
benefitSummary: Free/subsidized vocational training and entrepreneurial mentorship courses conducted through MSME-DFOs.

name: SAMARTH (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector)
description: Demand-driven, placement-oriented skilling programme partnering with organized textile industry and MSMEs.
benefitSummary: Free NSQF skilling, biometric-tracked assessment, wage compensation, and job placement in textile units.

name: ni-msme Executive & Managerial Capacity Building Modules
nodalAgency: National Institute for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (ni-msme)
description: Specialized residential and online executive management training courses in finance, marketing, and exports for MSME leaders.
benefitSummary: Subsidized executive management and industrial leadership certification courses.

name: Mahila Coir Yojana (under Coir Vikas Yojana)
description: Women-oriented programme providing 2 months coir spinning training, monthly stipend, and 75% subsidy on motorized ratts.
benefitSummary: 2-month skill training with monthly stipend of Rs. 3,000, plus 75% capital subsidy on motorized coir spinning equipment.

name: MSE-CDP - Common Facility Centres (CFC)
description: Grant assistance for establishing Common Facility Centres (testing labs, design studios, tool rooms, effluent plants) for industrial clusters.
benefitSummary: Grant assistance of 70% (up to 80% for special categories/NER) for projects with maximum ceiling of Rs. 30 Crore.

name: MSE-CDP - Infrastructure Development (ID) Projects
description: Financial grant for developing new industrial estates or upgrading infrastructure in existing industrial areas.
benefitSummary: Grant assistance of 60% (up to 70% for special categories) up to Rs. 15 Crore for industrial estate infrastructure.

name: ASPIRE - Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI)
description: Financial grant for setting up Livelihood Business Incubators providing hands-on manufacturing training on industrial equipment.
benefitSummary: One-time 100% grant of up to Rs. 1 Crore (for government bodies) or 50% up to Rs. 50 Lakh (for private entities).

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
description: Grant assistance for setting up Common Facility Centres, modern machinery, and market linkages for artisan collectives.
benefitSummary: Grant assistance up to Rs. 2.5 Crore (Regular Clusters: 500 artisans) and up to Rs. 5 Crore (Major Clusters: 1,000+ artisans).

name: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana (GVY) - Honey Mission & Kumhar Sashaktikaran
description: Free distribution of modern production toolkits (bee boxes, electric pottery wheels, toolkits) along with practical training.
benefitSummary: Free modern toolkits, processing equipment, and 5-10 day practical skill development training.

name: Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme (CITUS)
description: Provides 25% capital subsidy on procurement of modern coir processing plant and machinery.
benefitSummary: 25% capital subsidy on procurement of eligible plant and machinery up to a project ceiling of Rs. 2.50 Crore.

name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP) - Weavers MUDRA
nodalAgency: Office of Development Commissioner for Handlooms
description: Concessional credit scheme for handloom weavers providing margin money assistance, 7% interest subvention, and CGTMSE guarantee.
benefitSummary: Margin money up to Rs. 10,000 (up to Rs. 2 Lakh for collectives), 7% interest subvention, and collateral-free credit.

name: International Cooperation (IC) Scheme - Physical Participation in International Fairs
description: Financial subsidy covering economy airfare and stall charges for MSE delegations participating in international trade exhibitions.
benefitSummary: 100% economy airfare (up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh) and 100% stall charges (up to Rs. 3 Lakh) for foreign expos.

name: IC Scheme - Capacity Building of First-Time MSE Exporters (CBFTE)
description: Direct reimbursement of statutory registration and compliance costs incurred by first-time exporter MSEs for RCMC, ECGC insurance, and testing.
benefitSummary: 75% reimbursement of RCMC charges (up to Rs. 20,000), ECGC insurance (up to Rs. 10,000), and testing fees (up to Rs. 1 Lakh).

name: Market Access Initiative (MAI) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Department of Commerce)
description: Financial assistance for international market research, Reverse Buyer Seller Meets (RBSMs), and foreign product registration.
benefitSummary: Subsidized stall charges, airfare support, and up to 50% reimbursement of foreign statutory product registration.

name: Transport and Marketing Assistance (TMA) for Specified Agriculture Products
description: Financial assistance for international freight and logistics to mitigate export disadvantages for Indian agricultural products.
benefitSummary: Reimbursement of international air and ocean freight charges at prescribed rates per TEU/tonnage.

name: MSME Samadhaan (Delayed Payment Monitoring & Facilitation System)
description: Statutory legal arbitration mechanism under Sections 15-24 of MSMED Act 2006 for delayed payment recovery against buyers.
benefitSummary: Statutory recovery of overdue invoices beyond 45 days with mandatory compound interest at 3 times the RBI bank rate.

name: Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) Framework
ministry: Reserve Bank of India / Ministry of MSME
description: Electronic institutional auction platform enabling MSE suppliers to discount accepted trade invoices without recourse.
benefitSummary: Non-recourse, collateral-free instant invoice discounting at competitive bidding rates without blocking credit lines.

name: NSSH - Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) Fee Subsidy
description: 100% subsidy on NSIC registration and technical inspection fees for SC/ST MSEs under Single Point Registration Scheme.
benefitSummary: 100% waiver of application fee and technical inspection fee for NSIC Single Point Registration.

name: NSSH - Bank Loan Processing Fee and Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement
description: Reimbursement of bank loan processing fees and bank guarantee commission charges incurred by SC/ST MSEs.
benefitSummary: 100% reimbursement of processing fees on sanctioned loans, plus 100% reimbursement of bank guarantee commission (up to Rs. 1 Lakh/year).

name: PM-KUSUM Component A (Decentralized Solar Power Generation)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
description: Setting up grid-connected renewable power plants of capacity 500 kW to 2 MW on barren or rural land.
benefitSummary: 25-year guaranteed Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with local state DISCOM at feed-in tariffs.

name: Support for International Patent Protection in E&IT (SIP-EIT)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Financial reimbursement scheme providing up to 50% of expenses in filing international patent applications for ICT and electronics MSMEs.
benefitSummary: Reimbursement up to 50% of total patent filing expenses, subject to a maximum of Rs. 15 Lakh per invention.

name: PMKSY - Integrated Cold Chain and Value Addition Infrastructure
description: Financial assistance for creating integrated cold chain and preservation infrastructure from farm gate to consumer.
benefitSummary: Grant-in-aid of 35% for general areas and 50% for North East / difficult areas of eligible project cost up to max Rs. 10.00 Crore.

name: PMKSY - Creation of Infrastructure for Agro Processing Clusters (APC)
description: Grant for establishing common modern infrastructure to encourage entrepreneurs to set up food processing units.
benefitSummary: Grant-in-aid of 35% of eligible project cost in General areas and 50% in North East / Hilly / SC/ST areas, subject to maximum Rs. 10.00 Crore.

name: PMKSY - Operation Greens (Long Term Interventions)
description: Integrated value chain development for Tomato, Onion, Potato (TOP) and 22 notified perishable crops.
benefitSummary: Capital subsidy of 50% for general areas and 70% for FPOs/SC-ST in North East/Hilly states up to maximum Rs. 15.00 Crore.

name: PMKSY - Food Safety and Quality Assurance Infrastructure
description: Financial support for establishing and upgrading Food Testing Laboratories to ensure international safety compliance.
benefitSummary: Financial assistance of 50% of cost of laboratory equipment and 25% of technical civil works up to Rs. 10.00 Crore.

name: PMKSY - Creation of Backward and Forward Linkages (BFL)
description: Financial support for creating backward and forward linkages to food processing units. IMPORTANT STATUS NOTE: Fresh project proposals are no longer being accepted under this component; ongoing committed liabilities continue where applicable. Fresh food processing opportunities should be directed toward currently applicable PMKSY components such as CEFPPC and Agro Processing Clusters (APC).
benefitSummary: Grant-in-aid of 35% (50% for NE/Hilly areas) for ongoing committed linkage projects. (Fresh proposals discontinued; directed to PMKSY-CEFPPC/APC).

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
nodalAgency: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) / SIDBI
description: Incentivises investments by individual entrepreneurs, FPOs, and MSMEs in dairy and meat processing, animal feed plants, and breed multiplication.
benefitSummary: 3% interest subvention on bank loan up to 90% of project cost with 2 years moratorium and 8 years repayment tenure, plus 25% credit guarantee.

name: National Livestock Mission - Rural Poultry Entrepreneurship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing rural parent broiler/layer poultry breeding farms with hatchery units.
benefitSummary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 25.00 Lakh for establishing rural parent poultry farm (1,000 parent birds) with hatchery and brooder unit.

name: National Livestock Mission - Sheep and Goat Breed Development
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing intensive commercial sheep and goat breeding farms.
benefitSummary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for establishing sheep/goat breeding farms (up to 500 females + 25 males).

name: National Livestock Mission - Pig Breed Development Entrepreneurship
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing commercial pig breeding units.
benefitSummary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 30.00 Lakh for setting up pig breeding farms (100 sows + 10 boars).

name: National Livestock Mission - Fodder Production & Feed Pellet Entrepreneurship
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing feed pelleting plants, Total Mixed Ration (TMR) plants, or silage making units.
benefitSummary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for establishing feed/fodder pellet plants or silage processing units.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission - Breed Multiplication Farm Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing high-yielding indigenous bovine breed multiplication farms.
benefitSummary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 2.00 Crore for establishing high-yielding indigenous cattle/buffalo breeding farms (min 200 animals).

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana - Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for modern water-recirculating intensive fish aquaculture systems.
benefitSummary: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% for Women/SC/ST of unit cost up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for Medium RAS (Rs. 20-30 Lakh subsidy).

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana - Biofloc Aquaculture Units
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for high-density eco-friendly Biofloc fish/shrimp farming units.
benefitSummary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST of unit cost (up to Rs. 18.00 Lakh for Medium Biofloc 7-tank unit).

name: PMMSY - Refrigerated and Insulated Fish Transport Vehicles
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for purchasing refrigerated and insulated trucks for post-harvest fish transport.
benefitSummary: 40% financial assistance for General category and 60% for Women/SC/ST for Refrigerated Trucks (Rs. 25 Lakh cap) and Insulated Trucks (Rs. 15 Lakh cap).

name: PMMSY - Establishment of Fish Feed Mills
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for establishing Mini and Medium Fish Feed Mills to ensure affordable aquafeed availability.
benefitSummary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST for Mini Fish Feed Mills (Rs. 30 Lakh unit cost) and Medium Mills (Rs. 100 Lakh unit cost).

name: PMMSY - Open Sea Cage Culture / Mariculture
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for open sea cage culture and coastal mariculture projects.
benefitSummary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh per sea cage unit for marine fish farming.

name: PMMSY - Modern Fish Retail Outlets and Kiosks
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Financial assistance for establishing hygienic fish retail outlets and mobile fish kiosks.
benefitSummary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST of project cost (Rs. 10.00 Lakh for Kiosks; Rs. 30.00 Lakh for Retail Outlets).

name: MIDH - Integrated Pack House for Horticulture Produce
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Credit-linked back-ended capital subsidy for setting up integrated pack houses with mechanised grading, sorting, and packing lines.
benefitSummary: Credit linked back-ended subsidy of 35% of project cost in General areas and 50% in Hilly and Scheduled areas (max Rs. 25.00 Lakh).

name: MIDH - Cold Storage and Controlled Atmosphere (CA) Storage
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy for establishing modern energy-efficient Cold Storage (Type 1 & Type 2) and Controlled Atmosphere facilities.
benefitSummary: Credit linked back-ended capital subsidy of 35% for general areas and 50% for NE/Hilly states up to Rs. 1.75 Crore (5000 MT capacity).

name: MIDH - Ripening Chamber for Fruits
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy for establishing multi-chamber ethylene-based fruit ripening facilities.
benefitSummary: Credit linked back-ended subsidy of 35% in General areas and 50% in Hilly/NE areas for multi-chamber ripening units (cap Rs. 50.00 Lakh).

name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Financial assistance for organic value chain development, collection, packaging, and processing in North Eastern States.
benefitSummary: Financial support of 75% for FPOs/Lead Promoters up to Rs. 75.00 Lakh for setting up certified organic processing and packaging units.

name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Financial assistance for commercial scientific beekeeping, custom hiring centres, and honey processing plants.
benefitSummary: 50% to 75% financial assistance up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for setting up commercial beekeeping units, honey processing, and testing labs.

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Matching Equity Grant up to Rs. 15 Lakh and Credit Guarantee Cover up to Rs. 2 Crore for Farmer Producer Companies.
benefitSummary: Matching equity grant up to Rs. 15.00 Lakh per FPO and credit guarantee cover up to Rs. 2.00 Crore project loan.

name: PM-KUSUM Component B - Standalone Solar Agriculture Pumps
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
nodalAgency: State Renewable Energy Development Agencies / MNRE
description: Subsidies for installation of individual off-grid solar agriculture pumps up to 7.5 HP capacity.
benefitSummary: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) of 30% (50% in NE/Hilly states) + State subsidy 30%, farmer pays only 10-40% for solar pump.

name: PM-KUSUM Component C - Grid-Connected Pump Solarisation & Feeder Solarisation
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Financial assistance for solarising existing grid-connected agricultural pumps and dedicated agricultural feeders.
benefitSummary: CFA of 30% (50% in NE/Hilly states) for individual pumps or Rs. 1.05 Cr/MW for feeder level solarisation, enabling surplus power sale.

name: National Green Hydrogen Mission - SIGHT Programme
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
nodalAgency: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) / MNRE
description: Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) is a national institutional bidding framework under the National Green Hydrogen Mission. Financial incentives for domestic manufacturing of electrolysers and green hydrogen production are awarded via competitive tenders administered by SECI, rather than direct walk-in MSME grants.
benefitSummary: National competitive bidding incentives for electrolyser manufacturing (Rs. 4,440/kW down to Rs. 1,480/kW) and green hydrogen production (Rs. 50/kg down to Rs. 30/kg) awarded through SECI tenders.

name: PM Surya Ghar / Rooftop Solar Scheme for Commercial & Industrial MSMEs
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Concessional debt financing and tax incentives for commercial and industrial MSMEs installing rooftop solar PV systems. Note: Direct Central Financial Assistance (CFA) capital subsidies under PM Surya Ghar apply exclusively to residential consumers; commercial and industrial MSMEs access concessional debt financing via SIDBI (4E Scheme / Rooftop Solar Financing) and accelerated depreciation benefits under the Income Tax Act.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free concessional debt financing up to Rs. 2.00 Crore from SIDBI (4E Scheme) and commercial banks (7.0% to 8.5% p.a.) with accelerated depreciation tax benefits for MSME rooftop solar installations.

name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS - SIDBI)
description: Rs. 10,000 Crore corpus providing venture capital via SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) to high-growth Indian startups.
benefitSummary: Equity capital investment up to Rs. 50.00 Crore per eligible DPIIT-recognised startup via SIDBI partner AIFs.

name: Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) Scheme
description: Zero customs duty import of capital goods for pre-production, production, and post-production for export-oriented manufacturers and service providers.
benefitSummary: 100% customs duty exemption on import of capital goods/machinery subject to export obligation (6x duty saved in 6 years, 75% for MSMEs).

name: Advance Authorisation Scheme
description: Duty-free import of raw materials, components, and packaging materials required for manufacturing export goods.
benefitSummary: 100% exemption from Basic Customs Duty, IGST, and Compensation Cess on imported inputs with minimum 15% value addition.

name: Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP) Scheme
description: Rebate of un-refunded embedded central, state, and local taxes/duties incurred in the manufacture and distribution of exported goods.
benefitSummary: Electronic duty credit scrips ranging from 0.5% to 4.3% of FOB export value, freely transferable for paying basic customs duties.

name: Startup India 100% Tax Exemption (Section 80-IAC)
description: 100% income tax deduction on profits derived from eligible business for 3 consecutive assessment years out of 10 years.
benefitSummary: 100% tax holiday on corporate profits for 3 consecutive years for IMB-certified DPIIT startups.

name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Financial and mentoring support to tech startups utilizing emerging technologies (AI, IoT, Blockchain, Robotics, Cybersecurity).
benefitSummary: EiR fellowship grant up to Rs. 4.00 Lakh and Grant-in-Aid for Proof-of-Concept validation up to Rs. 7.00 Lakh per startup.

name: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme (Startup Accelerator of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development and Growth)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Matching acceleration funding and scaling support for existing software and hardware product startups.
benefitSummary: Matching acceleration grant / funding up to Rs. 40.00 Lakh per startup via empaneled accelerators, matched 1:1 with venture capital.

name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors (SPECS)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure for manufacturing electronic components, semiconductors, ATMP, and specialized assemblies. IMPORTANT STATUS NOTE: The window for submitting fresh applications closed on 31 March 2024; existing approved projects continue through implementation, milestone verification, and eligible incentive disbursement.
benefitSummary: 25% financial reimbursement of eligible capex on plant, machinery, and utilities for approved projects. (Fresh application window closed on 31 March 2024; active for ongoing execution and disbursement).

name: Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme for Semiconductor Design
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Financial incentives and design infrastructure support for domestic semiconductor and fabless chip design companies.
benefitSummary: Reimbursement up to 50% of eligible design expenditure (cap Rs. 15.00 Crore) and 6% to 4% deployment-linked incentive on net sales (cap Rs. 30.00 Crore).

name: PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks Scheme
description: World-class integrated industrial infrastructure with plug-and-play facilities and Competitive Incentive Support (CIS) for textile units.
benefitSummary: Development Capital Support up to Rs. 500 Crore per park and Competitive Incentive Support up to Rs. 300 Crore (up to Rs. 30 Cr per unit).

name: Silk Samagra 2 - Integrated Scheme for Development of Silk Industry
description: 50% to 75% financial assistance for mulberry and vanya sericulture, automated reeling units (ARM), and silk processing machinery.
benefitSummary: 50% to 75% subsidy on rearing appliances, automatic reeling machines, twisting units, and seed production (up to Rs. 35.00 Lakh).

name: National Handloom Development Programme - Block Level Clusters (BLC)
description: Financial grant for setting up Common Facility Centres, technological upgradation of looms/jacquards (up to 90% subsidy), and design interventions.
benefitSummary: Grant assistance up to Rs. 2.00 Crore per cluster for common facility centres, skill training, and 90% subsidy for modern looms/jacquards.

name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY) for Handicrafts Artisans
description: Comprehensive cluster development for handicraft artisans covering baseline surveys, modern toolkit distribution (100% subsidy), and CFC creation.
benefitSummary: Cluster assistance up to Rs. 1.50 Crore covering skill upgradation, design clinics, 100% toolkit subsidy, and market exhibitions.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles
description: Production Linked Incentive of 3% to 15% on incremental sales turnover for Man-Made Fibre (MMF) fabrics, garments, and Technical Textiles.
benefitSummary: Incentive of 3% to 15% on incremental turnover for 5 consecutive years with minimum investment of Rs. 100 Cr (Part 2) or Rs. 300 Cr (Part 1).

name: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting and Accelerating Young and ASpiring innovators)
nodalAgency: Department of Science and Technology (DST) / SINE IIT Bombay
description: Proof-of-concept grant support to convert an innovative hardware idea into a working physical prototype.
benefitSummary: Prototype grant-in-aid support up to Rs. 10.00 Lakh per innovator/startup along with fabrication lab access in PRAYAS Centres.

name: DST NIDHI-EIR (Entrepreneurs-in-Residence) Fellowship
description: Monthly fellowship grant to support aspiring technology entrepreneurs while developing their startup venture full-time.
benefitSummary: Monthly grant up to Rs. 30,000 per month for up to 18 months (total up to Rs. 5.40 Lakh) with dedicated mentorship and incubation support.

name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) Scheme
nodalAgency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) / DBT
description: Equity-free grant-in-aid funding for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and agri-biotech startups to establish proof-of-concept.
benefitSummary: Equity-free grant-in-aid up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for up to 18 months for biotech and healthcare startups.

name: BIRAC Small Business Innovation Research Initiative (SBIRI)
nodalAgency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) / DBT
description: Financial support for early-stage innovation and late-stage pre-commercialisation research by Indian biotech SMEs and startups.
benefitSummary: Grant-in-aid funding up to Rs. 5.00 Crore (up to 50% of project cost) for high-risk biotechnology industrial R&D.

name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)
description: Concessional credit up to 90% of project cost for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs for setting up viable income-generating enterprises.
benefitSummary: Term loan assistance up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh per unit at subsidized interest rate of 6% to 8% p.a. for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs.

name: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme for Minority Entrepreneurs
nodalAgency: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
description: Concessional credit for notified minorities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) to set up commercial and manufacturing enterprises.
benefitSummary: Concessional term loan up to Rs. 20.00 Lakh at 6% to 8% interest rate for notified minority entrepreneurs.

name: NMDFC Virasat Scheme for Minority Artisans and Craftsmen
nodalAgency: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
description: Concessional credit for craft equipment, raw materials, and working capital for traditional minority artisans.
benefitSummary: Concessional credit up to Rs. 10.00 Lakh for craft equipment and working capital at highly subsidized interest rate of 5% p.a. (4% for female artisans).

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd / MoSJE
description: Equity and quasi-equity financial support to foster entrepreneurship and innovation among Scheduled Castes.
benefitSummary: Equity and quasi-equity funding from Rs. 20.00 Lakh up to Rs. 15.00 Crore per enterprise with 60%+ SC shareholding.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Backward Classes (VCF-BC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nodalAgency: IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd / MoSJE
description: Concessional equity and debt financing for scalable commercial enterprises owned by Backward Classes.
benefitSummary: Concessional equity and debt funding from Rs. 20.00 Lakh up to Rs. 5.00 Crore for companies with 60%+ OBC shareholding.

name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes (CEGSSC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Credit enhancement guarantee cover for term loans and working capital sanctioned to SC-owned enterprises.
benefitSummary: 100% guarantee cover on collateral-free loans from Rs. 15.00 Lakh up to Rs. 5.00 Crore sanctioned to SC entrepreneurs.

name: RAMP - Green Investment and Financing for Transformation (GIFT) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Concessional green credit and interest subvention for MSMEs investing in clean energy, energy efficiency, and rooftop solar.
benefitSummary: Concessional green loans with interest subvention up to 2.50% and technical consulting support for energy efficiency upgrades.

name: RAMP - MSE Scheme for Promotion of Investment, Clean Energy and Circular Economy (MSE-SPICE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: 25% capital subsidy for Micro and Small Enterprises investing in circular economy, waste recycling, and pollution abatement.
benefitSummary: 25% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for MSEs investing in circular economy, waste recycling, and effluent treatment systems.

name: MSME Intellectual Property Facilitation Centre (IPFC) Sub-Component
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Sub-component under MSME Innovative Scheme (IPR Component) providing financial support for establishing Intellectual Property Facilitation Centres (IPFCs) and IP awareness/reimbursement for MSMEs.
benefitSummary: Financial support up to Rs. 1.00 Crore for establishing IPFCs and reimbursement support for patents, trademarks, and GIs under MSME Innovative Scheme.

name: Coir Board - Raw Material Bank (RMB) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Financial assistance for setting up Raw Material Banks to maintain buffer stocks of coir yarn, fibre, and pith for small coir spinners.
benefitSummary: Financial assistance of 50% of the cost of setting up Raw Material Banks up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh to ensure uninterrupted raw material supply.
